error: Labeling generation failed after 3 requests: CHANGES REQUIRED: The `blocker_moved` predicate is wrong. It checks whether the cell to the left of the door is free of a ball, which (a) hard-codes a relative offset rather than the cell directly in front of the door, and (b) does not account for the fact that the ball in the agent's hand counts as moved (the semantics say 'the cell in front of the door holds no ball; a ball in the agent's hand counts as moved'). The predicate should identify the locked door on the shared wall, compute the cell directly in front of it on the start side (the start room side), and return true only if that cell does not hold a ball — treating a ball currently carried by the agent as satisfying the condition. Also, the predicate must remain false if the ball is dropped back onto that cell; a current-observation check on the cell in front of the door naturally satisfies this. Fix `blocker_moved` to test the actual cell in front of the door instead of `cur_pos[0] - 1`.
